method: Visual inspection of rendered manufacturer diagrams; these observations are not OCR output.

bluepill-orientation.qualification: Reference-board orientation only; clone variants and component markings must be checked. H1/H2 are STM32-base connector labels; the reference schematic calls them P3/P4.

arduino-uno-r3.qualification: Top view; main MCU ICSP only. USB-bridge programming, barrel/USB sockets, test points and solder jumpers are excluded. Header contacts sharing a net are not independent GPIOs. Datasheet JDIGITAL A4/SD4 and A5/SD5 mean the SDA/A4 and SCL/A5 duplicate nets, as the full pinout and AVR core confirm.

arduino-nano-classic.qualification: Top view; main MCU ICSP only. USB-bridge programming, barrel/USB sockets, test points and solder jumpers are excluded. Header contacts sharing a net are not independent GPIOs. The ICSP pads are shown in top-view order, not the separately illustrated bottom view. A6/A7 are analog-only; the current Nano datasheet connector table has numbering and GPIO-label errors.

arduino-mega-2560.qualification: Top view; main MCU ICSP only. USB-bridge programming, barrel/USB sockets, test points and solder jumpers are excluded. Header contacts sharing a net are not independent GPIOs. Full-pinout page 3 rotates the end-header detail 90 degrees counterclockwise: with USB at top, ground is at the left and +5V at the right; the even GPIO row is nearer USB. The D0/D1 PWM markings in page 1 are contradicted by the official AVR core and are not used.

arduino-leonardo.qualification: Top-view main-header contacts visually reviewed. Shared family geometry does not imply identical MCU signals, ADC/PWM capabilities, or programming headers.
